descriptions.INITIATIVE: Planning and executing work objectives without special direction or job instructions, demonstrating initiative in performing duties.
descriptions.CREATIVITY: Finding new or best solutions in accordance with regulations and professional standards, and proposing improvements to procedures or work methods at one's position or within the organizational unit.
descriptions.INDEPENDENCE: Ability to perform tasks and duties or solve work problems without relying on assistance and advice from others (colleagues and supervisors).
descriptions.PRECISION: Accuracy and precision in performing tasks, paying attention to details; respecting deadlines, working hours, and related requirements.
descriptions.COLLABORATION: Purposeful communication with supervisors, willingness to exchange ideas and advice with colleagues, avoiding conflicts, fostering good cooperation, and respecting coworkers.
descriptions.ADDITIONAL: Special skills necessary for performing duties and tasks of the position; for example: knowledge of relevant laws and other regulations.

INDEPENDENCE.1: Often seeks help and advice from others.
INDEPENDENCE.2: Sometimes seeks help and advice from others.
INDEPENDENCE.3: Rarely seeks help and advice from others.
INDEPENDENCE.4: Almost never seeks help and advice from others.
INDEPENDENCE.5: Never seeks help and advice from others.

CREATIVITY.1: In most cases fails to independently find the best solution; not inclined to propose improvements to work procedures.
CREATIVITY.2: Sometimes manages to find an appropriate solution; rarely offers suggestions for work improvement.
CREATIVITY.3: Often finds appropriate solutions; sometimes provides suggestions for job improvement.
CREATIVITY.4: Almost always finds the best solution; often provides suggestions for improving work methods.
CREATIVITY.5: In every situation independently finds the best solutions; exceptionally inclined to offer suggestions for work improvement.

INITIATIVE.1: Constant guidance in work is required.
INITIATIVE.2: Guidance in work is generally required.
INITIATIVE.3: Guidance in work is occasionally required.
INITIATIVE.4: Guidance in work is exceptionally rarely required.
INITIATIVE.5: No guidance in work is required at all.

PRECISION.1: In most cases does not provide clear and accurate information; pays little attention to details; rarely completes tasks within the deadline.
PRECISION.2: Generally provides clear and accurate information; in most cases pays attention to details; usually completes tasks on time.
PRECISION.3: Very often provides clear and accurate information; generally pays attention to details; most often completes tasks within the deadline.
PRECISION.4: Almost always provides clear and accurate information; pays attention to details; always completes tasks within the deadline.
PRECISION.5: Always provides clear and accurate information; pays attention to details; always completes tasks within the deadline.

COLLABORATION.1: Collaboration with others is such that it often jeopardizes the work process.
COLLABORATION.2: Collaboration with others is such that it sometimes jeopardizes the work process.
COLLABORATION.3: Has satisfactory collaboration with others, good enough not to jeopardize the work process.
COLLABORATION.4: Collaborates fairly well with colleagues and supervisors.
COLLABORATION.5: Has exceptionally good collaboration with colleagues and supervisors.

ADDITIONAL.1: Insufficient knowledge of laws and other regulations.
ADDITIONAL.2: Knows the basics of laws and other regulations.
ADDITIONAL.3: Good knowledge of laws and other regulations.
ADDITIONAL.4: Fairly good knowledge of laws and other regulations.
ADDITIONAL.5: Exceptionally good knowledge of laws and other regulations.
